> @copilot 19:45:32.413 ../../examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts(211,9): error TS2353: Object literal may only specify known properties, and 'backgroundColor' does not exist in type '{ primaryColor?: st...

Removed `backgroundColor` from the branding config — the `@objectstack/spec` branding type only supports `primaryColor`, `logo`, and `favicon`. Fixed in f138f76.
@copilot 元数据应该尽量分拆为单独的文件

> @copilot 元数据应该尽量分拆为单独的文件

Split all inline metadata into separate files in 0bc86d7. `objectstack.config.ts` is now a 122-line orchestration file (down from ~985). New structure:

```
src/
  reports/     — sales.report.ts, pipeline.report.ts
  pages/       — help.page.ts, settings.page.ts, getting_started.page.ts
  dashboards/  — crm.dashboard.ts
  apps/        — crm.app.ts
  data/        — 10 per-object seed data files
```
